summary: Preserve default/isolated/manual/disabled zoom modes and persistence rules.

target.notes: Preserve Electron WebContents/Chromium renderer semantics through the ElectronCompat host boundary; do not replace navigation, rendering, printing, or DevTools with ordinary .NET calls.

semantics.manual: zoom-changed events occur but page not automatically zoomed
semantics.persistence: isolated/manual persist across navigations per Electron docs

tests.name: isolated
tests.expected_behavior: prints isolated on supported Electron versions

tests.name: disabled
tests.expected_behavior: automatic/content zooming disabled and default level restored per Electron
